tools.description: Create independently placeable items from an ordered items array of catalog productIds and return each item's actual position, rotation and size after insertion. Repeated products create separate items. Results include ordered indices and success/failure counts; failed items do not stop later items. No automatic retries or batch rollback. Positions use complete { x, y, z } objects, in inputs and results. Size uses { x, y, z } for width, depth and height; all three positive axes are required when provided. A z of 0 or an omitted position is resolved to the model's floor height, so trust the returned position rather than the requested one. Covers everything that can be moved and placed as a whole, including soft furnishings, appliances and hard-decoration or building components: finished furniture, decorative accessories, lighting and appliances, background walls and wall panels, ceilings, curtains, partitions, stairs and railings. Each is placed as one complete piece, never built up from boards or parts.

items.description: Items to create in order. Repeated products create separate items.

position.description: Center position. Omit, or pass 0 for z, to let the model drop onto the floor.

productId.description: Catalog productId of the item to create, as returned by get or catalog search.

size.description: Absolute local dimensions { x: width, y: depth, z: height } in millimetres. All axes are required.

tools.description: Read independently placeable items in the current design: id, productId, position, exact rotation and size. Millimetres and radians; positions and sizes are { x, y, z } objects. Size axes mean width, depth and height. Omit ids to read everything. Covers everything that can be moved and placed as a whole, including soft furnishings, appliances and hard-decoration or building components: finished furniture, decorative accessories, lighting and appliances, background walls and wall panels, ceilings, curtains, partitions, stairs and railings. Each is placed as one complete piece, never built up from boards or parts.

ids.description: Furniture IDs to read. Omit to read every furniture in the current design.

tools.description: Read the replaceable material slots of independently placeable items using a nonempty ids array: each slot id, the model default parameters, the replacement currently applied and any texture transform. Returns furnitures and missingIds in first-occurrence order, ignoring duplicate IDs. Use a returned slot id as the blockId of set_materials. Covers everything that can be moved and placed as a whole, including soft furnishings, appliances and hard-decoration or building components: finished furniture, decorative accessories, lighting and appliances, background walls and wall panels, ceilings, curtains, partitions, stairs and railings. Each is placed as one complete piece, never built up from boards or parts.

ids.description: Furniture IDs whose material slots to read. Duplicates are ignored.

tools.description: Remove independently placeable items by id and report which IDs were actually deleted. IDs that do not exist and read-only furniture are reported instead of being retried. Covers everything that can be moved and placed as a whole, including soft furnishings, appliances and hard-decoration or building components: finished furniture, decorative accessories, lighting and appliances, background walls and wall panels, ceilings, curtains, partitions, stairs and railings. Each is placed as one complete piece, never built up from boards or parts.

ids.description: Furniture IDs to remove. Duplicates are ignored.

tools.description: Replace material slots across independently placeable items using an ordered items array, and optionally set their texture transform, without opening the material editor. Each slot takes exactly one of targetMaterialId or productId, as returned by the catalog search. Slots that are not listed keep their material. Returns per-item readback slots and success/failure counts. Resolved slots apply even when other slots are unresolved; inspect each item's unresolvedBlockIds. Repeated furniture IDs execute sequentially; failed items do not stop later items. No automatic retries or batch rollback. Covers everything that can be moved and placed as a whole, including soft furnishings, appliances and hard-decoration or building components: finished furniture, decorative accessories, lighting and appliances, background walls and wall panels, ceilings, curtains, partitions, stairs and railings. Each is placed as one complete piece, never built up from boards or parts.

items.description: Furniture material changes to apply in order.

materials.description: Slots to change. Slots not listed keep their current material.

blockId.description: Material slot to change, as returned by get_materials.

productId.description: Fallback product identifier when the search returned no material id.

targetMaterialId.description: Material id from the catalog search.

uv.description: Texture transform for this slot. Omit to leave the current one untouched.

angle.description: Texture rotation in radians. Omit to keep the current value.

scale.description: Texture scale. Omit to keep the current value.

x.description: Texture rotation in radians. Omit to keep the current value.

y.description: Texture rotation in radians. Omit to keep the current value.

translation.description: Texture offset. Omit to keep the current value.

x.description: Texture rotation in radians. Omit to keep the current value.

y.description: Texture rotation in radians. Omit to keep the current value.

tools.description: Change the position, rotation and/or size of independently placeable items using an ordered items array. Return each resulting state and success/failure counts. Repeated furniture IDs are updated sequentially; failed items do not stop later items. No automatic retries or batch rollback. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Millimetres and radians, absolute values. Positions use complete { x, y, z } objects, in inputs and results. Size uses { x, y, z } for width, depth and height; only supplied positive axes change. Resizing keeps the model's ground clearance, so it can also move the furniture vertically — the returned position is authoritative. Covers everything that can be moved and placed as a whole, including soft furnishings, appliances and hard-decoration or building components: finished furniture, decorative accessories, lighting and appliances, background walls and wall panels, ceilings, curtains, partitions, stairs and railings. Each is placed as one complete piece, never built up from boards or parts.

items.description: Updates to apply in order, including repeated furniture IDs.

furnitureId.description: ID of the furniture to change.

position.description: Absolute world center { x, y, z } in millimetres. All three finite coordinates are required.

size.description: Absolute local dimensions { x: width, y: depth, z: height } in millimetres; only supplied axes change.
